body:
Hey there! Writing is eating up your business hours, and AI can genuinely help. Here are the tools your competitors are already using.

**This Week's Top Picks**

**Notion AI**
Summarize meeting notes, brainstorm product ideas, and write directly inside your workspace without switching apps. Best for: Teams already using Notion who want AI without extra subscriptions. *Free + $10/mo* → [Try Notion AI Free →](https://notion.so/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Copy.ai**
Generate marketing copy—emails, social posts, ad headlines—in seconds. You get templates, not generic output. Best for: Small business owners who need fast copy variations without hiring a copywriter. *Free + $36/mo* → [Try Copy.ai Free →](https://copy.ai/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Surfer SEO**
Write or optimize content with built-in SEO guidance so Google actually ranks it. This isn't just checking keywords—it rewrites for relevance and readability. Best for: Anyone blogging seriously who's tired of invisible content. *$89/mo* → [Try Surfer SEO →](https://surferseo.com/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Quick Tip**

Stop treating AI as a finished product. Use it for first drafts—outlines, rough copy, email structures—then edit ruthlessly. Your voice matters more than speed. A tool can give you 80% of the way there in 5 minutes; you spend 10 minutes making it sound like you, not a robot.

**The Bottom Line**

These five tools handle different jobs: Notion for workspace integration, Copy.ai for quick marketing snippets, Writesonic for longer-form content, Jasper for campaigns, and Surfer for SEO-friendly blogs. Pick one and master it before adding another.

See you next week with more tools that actually work.
